title: Week 1 Analysis
subtitle: The locks are already cracking.
intro_paragraphs: One week of real football is in the books, and it's already rough on the room's preseason confidence. Here's how the picks are holding up against reality so far.

fun_facts.heading: Six of Eight Locks Already Broke
fun_facts.body: Of the eight picks every single bettor agreed on before the season, only two survived Week 1: Pittsburgh third and Cleveland fourth in the AFC North. Everything else the room was unanimous about took a hit. The Bills, who all seven of you had winning the AFC East, are currently second behind the Jets. The Lions, unanimous favorites in the NFC North, are behind the Vikings. And the biggest swing of the week: the Rams, who every single bettor picked to win the NFC West outright, are sitting dead last in it — the same slot the room reserved for the Cardinals.

fun_facts.heading: Tight at the Top, a Cliff at the Bottom
fun_facts.body: The pool is bunched up at the top and split at the bottom. Dustin (40), Cadegn (38), Mike T (37), Farmer (36), and Tom (34) are separated by only six points total — Cadegn and Mike T are the tightest gap in the whole leaderboard, just one point apart. Then there's a 12-point cliff down to Dilger (22) and Hume (20), who are already playing from behind.

fun_facts.heading: The Contrarians Are Cashing In
fun_facts.body:
Remember Cadegn's lone-wolf call from the preseason report — the only ballot with the Giants winning the NFC East over the more popular Eagles and Cowboys? One week in, the Giants are actually sitting in first place. Cadegn and Farmer's shared read on Jacksonville over Houston in the AFC South is holding too — they're the only two bettors with a correct division-leader pick there.

Across the board, nobody's division-winner bets are having a good week: Mike T and Cadegn lead the pool with 2 of their 8 division-winner picks currently right, and Dilger is still waiting on the first one to hit.

closing_paragraph: One week doesn't make a season, but the locks are already cracking and the contrarians are cashing in first. Check back next Tuesday.
